adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16
adds.text: Hall's mind inside the Gravitonium wants Quinn, and when Raina opens the container it pulls Quinn in. Trapped together, the two minds argue without end.

adds.evidence: Inside Voices (S5#16): a flashback shows Raina saying the Gravitonium wants Quinn before it absorbs him; Quinn is the second voice Hall's voice argues with in Creel's head. All Roads Lead (S5#18): Creel tells Hale Hall wanted revenge but is stuck with Quinn forever.

adds.evidence: The End (S5#22): Simmons provides Coulson with the Centipede serum, he refuses it and hides it in Daisy's gauntlets, then bids his agents farewell and leaves for Tahiti.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
owner_calls.question: Hall's mind in the Gravitonium, through Creel, wants Coulson dead, and Creel attacks Coulson because of it (S5#16). Is that enough for a stage between Hall and Coulson?
options: Add enemy at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16: through Creel, Hall's mind in the Gravitonium wants Coulson dead
owner_calls.evidence: Inside Voices: upon hearing Coulson's name in Hall's memories, Creel assaults Coulson, claiming the Gravitonium wants him dead; the voices agree Coulson should die.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
owner_calls.question: Quinn's mind in the Gravitonium is one of the voices in Creel's head agreeing Coulson should die (S5#16). Is that enough for a stage between Quinn and Coulson?
options: Add enemy at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#16: Quinn's mind in the Gravitonium wants Coulson dead
owner_calls.evidence: Inside Voices: Creel hears voices constantly arguing but agreeing that Coulson should die; the flashback reveals Quinn as the second voice.
